mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fin_bill WHERE partner_id = #{id} AND kind = 'AR') THEN '应收单' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fin_invoice WHERE partner_id = #{id} AND kind = 'OUTPUT') THEN '销项发票' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fin_advance WHERE partner_id = #{id} AND kind = 'RECEIPT') THEN '预收款' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fin_offset WHERE partner_id = #{id} AND kind = 'AR') THEN '冲账单' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fin_io_doc WHERE partner_id = #{id} AND partner_type = 'CUSTOMER') THEN '其他收支单' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fin_netting WHERE customer_id = #{id}) THEN 'fin.label.nettingDoc' END

SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fin_bill WHERE partner_id = #{id} AND kind = 'AP') THEN '应付单' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fin_invoice WHERE partner_id = #{id} AND kind = 'INPUT') THEN '进项发票' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fin_advance WHERE partner_id = #{id} AND kind = 'PAYMENT') THEN '预付款' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fin_offset WHERE partner_id = #{id} AND kind = 'AP') THEN '冲账单' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fin_io_doc WHERE partner_id = #{id} AND partner_type = 'SUPPLIER') THEN '其他收支单' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fin_netting WHERE supplier_id = #{id}) THEN 'fin.label.nettingDoc' END
SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fin_voucher WHERE create_by = #{id}) THEN '凭证' END
SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fin_voucher_entry WHERE dept_id = #{id}) THEN '凭证分录' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fin_io_doc WHERE dept_id = #{id}) THEN '其他收支单' END

SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fin_commission_rule x JOIN wms_material_category c ON c.code = x.material_category WHERE c.id = #{id}) THEN 'fin.label.commissionRule' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fin_account_rule x JOIN wms_material_category c ON c.code = x.dim_value WHERE c.id = #{id} AND x.role IN ('INVENTORY', 'REVENUE')) THEN 'fin.label.voucherAccountSettings' END
SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fin_account WHERE store_id = #{id}) THEN 'fin.label.storeSettlementAccount' END
